verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform docs list both regular payroll processing for employees and contractor payment management in the same product. Dedicated contractor-payment docs cover direct deposit, check and historical payment methods, and the People Batch API explicitly handles W-2 employees. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of 1099 form filing for contractors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running mixed W-2/1099 payments together.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Process regular and off-cycle payrolls * Calculate and file taxes automatically * Import historical payroll data * Handle multi-state tax requirements * Manage contractor payments
Contractors can have three types of payment methods: 1. Direct deposit: Gusto will deposit the funds to the bank account associated with the contractor.
